title: Rabbits

source.name: Simple English Wikipedia — Rabbit
source.note: Chuyển thể sang mức A1 (câu ngắn, từ đơn giản); thông tin theo bài gốc.

paras: Rabbits are animals. They are mammals. Rabbits live in many parts of the world. They live in families. They eat vegetables and hay. Some people have rabbits as pets.

Wild rabbits live in holes under the ground. The holes are called burrows. Rabbits dig their burrows themselves. A group of rabbits in a burrow is called a warren. A male rabbit is called a buck. A female rabbit is called a doe. A baby rabbit is called a kit.
